truths.truth: The gate's halt decision consumes adjudicated state: the real v3.7.7 record's already-fixed high does not halt, and the same set with that one fix_commit removed does.
truths.evidence: Live end-to-end, not the test's own fixture. Piped `git show 220f99d3:.planning/phases/2/ADJUDICATION-risk_surface-plan-1-r2.json` entries[] into `node cadence-core/bin/land-cleanup.mjs gate --dir /code/cadence` (.planning/config.json has git.auto_close=true) -> {"action":"proceed","findings":[],"overridden":[],"reason":"auto_close on, no surviving blocker/high finding left genuinely unfixed: proceed to merge"}. Same array with only the :460 high's fix_commit key deleted -> {"action":"halt","findings":[{...line 460...}],"reason":"auto_close on with a genuinely-unfixed surviving risk_surface finding"}. Traced across both seams: entries enter at land-cleanup.mjs:238 readFindings (stdin), are classified at :246 by unfixedFromEntries (lib/filing-decision.mjs:179-197), and land in decideGateHalt at :247. The inlined fixture in land-cleanup.test.mjs:378-458 is byte-faithful to the git-show output. `node --test --test-name-pattern="v3\.7\.7" cadence-core/bin/land-cleanup.test.mjs` -> tests 4, pass 4, fail 0.

truths.truth: The genuinely-unfixed meaning has exactly one definition in the executable tree, proved by a test that reddens if a second one appears, and close-decision.mjs no longer spells the severity half.
truths.evidence: `grep -n "'blocker'\|'high'" cadence-core/bin/lib/close-decision.mjs` -> no output, exit 1 (only the prose words appear, in comments and reason strings). The census row is helper-census.test.mjs:212-238, a body-idiom regex (`ruling === 'survived' && HALTING_SEVERITIES\.includes\(` ... `overridden !== true`) run tree-wide over every .mjs under cadence-core/bin/. Redden-on-demand exercised for real: copied cadence-core/bin/ to a scratch tree, ran the row (pass 1, fail 0), then added lib/second-copy.mjs holding a paste of that body -> AssertionError "the genuinely-unfixed test (unfixedFromEntries) must be defined exactly once, in lib/filing-decision.mjs; found in lib/filing-decision.mjs (x1), lib/second-copy.mjs (x1)". Scope is total: `find . -name "*.mjs" -not -path "./cadence-core/bin/*"` returns nothing, so the walk covers the whole executable tree; `grep -rn "ruling === 'survived'" --include="*.mjs"` shows lib/filing-decision.mjs:189 as the only conjunction, the rest being counts, composition-time checks or fixtures. issue-filing.mjs's old `!e.fix_commit` filter is gone (`grep -n fix_commit cadence-core/bin/issue-filing.mjs` -> no output).

The fail-closed arm works too: a PRESENT non-list unruled (a bare string) -> halt, "(unruled: string, not a list of review paths)" (land-cleanup.mjs:124-128 readUnruled). The state stands beside the four rather than folding into one - lib/close-decision.mjs:171-175 is its own arm after the unreadable arm at :167. Named test `v3.7.7 (c): the same review with nothing ruling it halts as unruled-review` passes.

truths.truth: The adjudicated state survives /cad-milestone's prune of the phase directories, and the gate's contract comment states what it reads and where that comes from.
truths.evidence: Reproduced end to end on a scratch fixture, not read off the plan. Built .planning/phases/3/ with a REVIEW plus an ADJUDICATION holding one survived high and no fix_commit; gate -> halt on that entry. Ran `planning.mjs --dir <S>/.planning risk-carry --phase 3` -> ok:true, copied 2, both files to risk-carry/3/ with basenames preserved. Ran `planning.mjs --dir <S>/.planning milestone-prune --label v9.9.9 --mode delete` -> ok:true, dirs.deleted [3]; `find` confirms phases/3/ is gone entirely. Rebuilt the payload from risk-carry/3/ alone and re-ran gate -> byte-identical payload (`cmp` says IDENTICAL) and the identical halt verdict. Wiring: cmdRiskCarry registered at planning.mjs:231 and :312, arg-contract row at lib/arg-contract.mjs:884; workflows/milestone.md:110 invokes it and prose-agreement.test.mjs:1320-1395 pins carry-before-prune by file position and pins that only /cad-land step 4 clears the carry (67 of 67 prose-agreement tests pass). The contract comment is land-cleanup.mjs:36-56, naming both record roots (.planning/phases/*/ and .planning/risk-carry/<N>/), every round, the classification through lib/filing-decision.mjs, and that the gate reads stdin and nothing else. planning-risk-carry.test.mjs: tests 14, pass 14, including `risk-carry + milestone-prune --mode delete: the same verdict, off the carried records`.
